title: Eventual vanishing of cartesian higher-image germs
statement: Let k be a field, D:I→Over(Spec k) a small cofiltered diagram of qcqs schemes over k with affine transition maps, c a cone whose underlying scheme cone is limiting with qcqs structure map, f:X→Spec k qcqs, F an arbitrary abelian étale sheaf on X, and q≥0. Fix a geometric point at s of c.pt.left. If a stage fiber element maps to zero in the limiting cartesian higher-image fiber, then some later transition sends it to zero. Here stages, legs and transitions are the canonical constructions in the cited statement dependencies. No hypothesis of invertible stage exchange is imposed.

source.place: Lemma 59.51.8, second proof; support statement isolated by S4

proof.text: Represent the stalk element on an etale neighbourhood and refine the equality with zero to an affine etale neighbourhood. The affine section vanishing theorem then supplies a later stage killing the restriction; stalk naturality transports this to the original germ.

proof_origin.place: Second proof, local affine section reduction

theorem exists_cartesianHigherImage_germ_eq_zero
    {k : Type u} [Field k]
    {I : Type u} [SmallCategory I] [IsCofiltered I]
    (D : I ⥤ Over (Spec (.of k)))
    [∀ i, QuasiCompact (D.obj i).hom] [∀ i, QuasiSeparated (D.obj i).hom]
    [∀ {i j : I} (a : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map a).left]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit ((Over.forget _).mapCone c))
    [QuasiCompact c.pt.hom] [QuasiSeparated c.pt.hom]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (q : ℕ) (s : c.pt.left)
    (i : I) (x : ((c.pt.left.uliftPointSmallEtale s).sheafFiber
        (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj
      (cartesianHigherImageStage D c f F q i))
    (hx : (((c.pt.left.uliftPointSmallEtale s).sheafFiber
        (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).map
      (cartesianHigherImageLeg D c f F q i)) x = 0) :
    ∃ (j : I) (a : j ⟶ i),
      (((c.pt.left.uliftPointSmallEtale s).sheafFiber
        (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).map
        (cartesianHigherImageTransition D c f F q a)) x = 0
